jobs.description:
** Can be based in any Eastern European country **

About IWG

IWG is the world’s largest provider of flexible workspace, with more than 5,000 locations
across 120 + countries
. We bring together leading brands such as Regus, Spaces, HQ and Signature, as well as digital marketplace platforms such as Instant Offices, Easy Offices and Coworker. For over 35 years, we’ve enabled organisations of every size—from start-ups and scale-ups to 83% of the Fortune 500—to work more productively, flexibly and sustainably.

Our purpose is simple: help everyone have a great day at work—while protecting people and the planet. We offer carbon-neutral workplaces worldwide and are moving towards achieving Net Zero emissions.

In 2025, IWG delivered record system‑wide revenue of $4.5B
driven by rapid expansion of our capital‑light partnership model. This will continue in 2026 where we will have a target of over 1500 new centre deals as we accelerate towards our long term ambition of 30,000 centres world-wide.

Join us- www.iwgplc.com

Job Purpose

The Project Manager is accountable for the clear definition, structured delivery, and controlled execution of projects from initiation through to deployment.

This role requires the ability to frame complex initiatives, establish robust governance, and manage delivery across multiple workstreams while maintaining strong stakeholder alignment. Successful candidates will be qualified practitioners with the ability to frame projects clearly, manage delivery through defined lifecycle stages, and operate confidently within formal governance structures.

Key Responsibilities

Develop end-to-end operational roadmaps, manage timelines, and track milestones aligned with corporate governance frameworks
Establish operational metrics and report on productivity, cost, and service quality
Lead internal transitions, facilitate stakeholder communication, and train staff on new operational systems or policies

Required Qualifications, Experience, Behaviours

Education: Operations Management, Project Management, or a related field. PMP (Project Management Professional), PRINCE2, or Lean Six Sigma certification preferred but not essential
Proficiency in project portfolio tools (e.g., MS Project, Asana, Jira) and data analysis/dashboard software.
Strong cross-functional leadership, advanced analytical thinking, transparent communication, and high emotional intelligence
Consistently delivered results, above expectations
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence in a matrix environment
Confident decisionmaker who demonstrates sound judgement
Organised, consistently delivers against tight deadlines
Collaborative team player and a commitment to excellence
Analytical mindset with the ability to solve problems and improve processes. Comfortable working in a fast‑paced environment
Resilient, able to deal with ambiguity

What We Can Do For You

You are reading the right advert if you are looking for:

A fun, challenging, and rewarding career.
Award-winning induction training and excellent ongoing learning and development.
Fantastic career progression opportunities.
Access to a comprehensive selection of flexible, personalised workplace benefits that support your mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.

Recruitment process

Our recruitment process is transparent and objective, because we care about your experience with us. We will respond to you within a few days to let you know if you are moving to the interview stage. This usually starts with a 30 minute conversation with our Global Recruitment Team, giving you the chance to learn more about us and the job. If we both feel there’s a good fit and connection, you will progress through one or two further stages, depending on the level of the position. IWG is proud to be recognised as a Leading Employer,
every year since 2022.

jobs.title: (Senior) Program Manager - Toxicology
jobs.description:
WuXi AppTec is a leading global pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and medical device open-access capability and technology platform with worldwide operations. As an innovation-driven and customer-focused platform, WuXi AppTec provides a broad and integrated portfolio of services to help global customers and partners shorten the discovery and development timeline and reduce the cost of drug and medical device R&D through efficient and cost-effective solutions.

Within our Testing Division, we provide world-class, globally integrated testing solutions to support drug development. We are committed to helping scientists transform innovative ideas into leading healthcare products, accelerating the journey from the laboratory to the clinic, and ultimately improving human health.

We are currently seeking a Program Manager/Sr. Program Manager
(depending on experience) to join the Toxicology Strategic Programs team as a U.S.-based remote employee
.

This role requires close collaboration with both the U.S. and Europe BD teams, as well as the TOX Commercial Operations Center (TOX COC) in China. The primary working language is English, but due to the need for deep engagement and communication, fluency in Mandarin is highly desired. Preferred location is the U.S. East Coast, particularly the Boston area.

The Program Manager will primarily support and manage Toxicology BU clients’ IND (Investigational New Drug) programs and oversee drug development progress. He/She will work closely with the LTD International Sales teams, Commercial Market team, TOX COC, TOX SD teams, scientists, and staff at WuXi’s Suzhou, Nantong sites.

Work independently or under supervision in a highly motivated program management team and dynamic environment.
Provide technical support during the business development phase, including but not limited to: understanding IND submission requirements of the U.S., China, and EMA; evaluating clients’ development programs; and preparing program proposals and preliminary study designs based on compound characteristics, clinical indications, intended clinical trial plans, existing data, and target submission regions.
Lead and manage the nonclinical TOX portion of IND-enabling programs: develop program execution plans (Gantt charts), monitor program progress across toxicology, preclinical bioanalysis, and regulatory submission activities; host regular project meetings to review status, study results, issues, and resolutions; and coordinate with other divisions for extended IND programs when needed.
Provide continuous scientific and technical support during program execution, proactively identify potential issues, and propose constructive solutions.
Maintain timely communication with clients and key internal contributors across functions/business units via email, teleconferences, Zoom meetings, and/or site visits to ensure smooth program execution.
Track relevant scientific advances by reviewing literature and sharing updates with the team and business units.

Education & Experience

PhD, or MS degree in Toxicology, Pharmacology, DMPK, or related fields.
2 - 3 years of post-PhD experience, or 5+ years of experience after a Master’s degree.
Experience with in vitro or in vivo studies in drug discovery and development required; background in Toxicology and/or DMPK strongly preferred.
Program management experience in leading nonclinical programs preferred.
Excellent English verbal and written communication skills; fluency in Mandarin is requried.
Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
Highly independent with strong accountability.
Ability to conduct research and perform literature reviews.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

Strong oral and written communication skills.
Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and other relevant software.
Strong organizational skills, detail-oriented, and adaptable to changes.
Ability to manage multiple programs under tight deadlines.
Strong prioritization and flexibility in managing changing directions.
Team-oriented mindset with flexibility to work across time zones.
Familiarity with and adherence to regulatory guidelines consistent with company requirements.

The expected annual base salary for this position is $110,000 to $130,000.

jobs.description:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.
Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As an Deployment Strategist on the Future Platforms team, you'll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that centers on strategic execution, with real influence over the product and the motion around it.

You'll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you'll run engagements and help systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to own complex deployment outcomes end-to-end: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment
Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices
Run the execution motion: Hold a full book of concurrent deployments at different stages; coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders; keep cadence, risk tracking, and launch readiness current on every one without dropping threads
Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness
Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption
Support change management: Partner with client leadership on communicating the change through their organization, and identify where workflows or incentives need to shift for adoption to stick
Inform product development: Bring net-new workflow and product requirements to Product/Engineering, grounded in scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage
Contribute to the playbook: Feed lessons from engagements into the processes and templates that improve speed and quality as we scale
Support sales and expansion: Participate in later-stage sales and pre-sales discovery to set up successful engagements; help scope realistic engagements and identify follow-on opportunities
Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for founder-minded leaders who take pride in getting complex enterprise deployments live and keeping them healthy. You likely have:

5–8 years running enterprise software implementations, platform migrations, or technology transformation programs, for example implementation and delivery roles at enterprise SaaS companies, technology consulting, or systems integration
Demonstrated track record of taking enterprise deployments live: you can speak to specific implementations you’ve owned, the obstacles you hit, and how you got to launch
Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background
Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting
Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders
Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail
Willingness to travel ~2x per month for ~2-3 days
Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

Equity in the company
Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%
Fully paid parental leave
Commuter benefits
401k benefits
Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters
A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office
Unlimited vacation and paid holidays
We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000 USD/CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

Description

PURPOSE

The Business Analyst conducts moderate-to-high complexity analysis of automated surveillance systems that detect potential violations of regulatory rules. This role is responsible for understanding, validating, enhancing, and supporting surveillance patterns across multiple asset classes and regulatory domains. The analyst serves as the bridge between regulatory requirements and the technical implementation of surveillance logic, ensuring patterns produce accurate, complete, and defensible results. The analyst is expected to actively leverage generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, and automation — serving as the domain expert who directs AI capabilities while ensuring regulatory accuracy and completeness of all outputs.

Core Functions

Surveillance Pattern Analysis & Knowledge Management

Reverse-engineers surveillance pattern source code to build comprehensive knowledge documentation covering data pipelines, business rules, exception logic, and output schemas
Maintains a knowledge base of surveillance patterns across multiple regulatory domains
Performs requirements-vs-code gap analysis to identify discrepancies between documented business requirements and implemented logic, flagging risks to surveillance coverage

UAT & Release Validation

Validates new surveillance pattern releases by comparing production vs. UAT outputs, analyzing exception counts, volumes, and firm-level impacts
Builds local testing environments to execute query scripts against sample data, enabling independent verification of pattern logic before production deployment
Designs multi-scenario test cases covering edge cases to ensure comprehensive test coverage
Packages release artifacts (scripts, QC results, requirements documentation) following standardized release structures

Ad-Hoc Data Analysis & Investigation Support

Writes complex queries to support analyst investigations into surveillance exceptions
Performs firm-level statistical analysis and produces reports for management review
Maintains reference data sets used by downstream surveillance patterns
Assesses data incident impacts by cross-referencing affected data sources against the surveillance pattern dependency map

Process Automation & Tooling

Develops automation tools for ticket management, release documentation, and workflow optimization
Builds local testing frameworks that replicate production environments for rapid pattern testing and iteration
Creates data visualization and comparison reports with interactive views, summary statistics, and color-coded differentials

Generative AI Integration & Prompt Engineering

Leverages AI coding assistants as a force multiplier — directing AI agents to reverse-engineer source code, build knowledge documentation, generate test frameworks, and produce data comparison reports
Designs structured AI workflows including pattern study pipelines, workflow assistants, and automated documentation generation
Maintains a curated AI project workspace with standing instructions, conventions, and context files that enable consistent, high-quality AI-assisted output
Coordinates multi-step analytical tasks through AI — from reading source code and drafting requirements, to generating test harnesses and producing comparison reports — reducing turnaround from days to hours
Evaluates and validates AI-generated outputs for regulatory accuracy before use in production workflows

Project Management Support

Manages work across project tracking boards, tracking enhancement tickets, bug fixes, and new pattern development
Drafts and updates Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) for surveillance pattern enhancements
Coordinates release activities including documentation, QC, and UAT sign-off tracking

Other Responsibilities

Participates on special projects as assigned. Serves as a mentor for less experienced analysts. Keeps management updated on notable trends in industry practices, regulatory changes, and emerging technology capabilities (including AI tooling). Champions adoption of AI-assisted workflows within the team.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience in financial regulatory technology, surveillance systems, or capital markets data analysis
Proficiency in SQL for large-scale data analysis on distributed platforms
Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language for data analysis, automation, and tool development
Experience reading and interpreting complex data processing pipelines and business logic in source code
Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently investigate data discrepancies and validate system outputs
Excellent documentation skills — ability to translate complex technical implementations into clear business-facing knowledge documents
Advanced proficiency in spreadsheet tools for business and operational analysis

Preferred

Major in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, or related field; advanced degree preferred
Knowledge of SEC/FINRA regulatory rules and reporting requirements
Experience with distributed query engines and big data platforms
Experience with project management and documentation tools and their APIs
Familiarity with surveillance pattern architectures (exception generation, scoring, aggregation, reconciliation)
Experience with source code management and release branch workflows
Experience leveraging generative AI tools (LLMs, AI coding assistants) to accelerate data analysis, code comprehension, documentation, and automation workflows
Ability to design effective AI prompts and structured project contexts that produce reliable, domain-accurate outputs in a regulated environment

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.
Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As an Deployment Strategist on the Future Platforms team, you'll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that centers on strategic execution, with real influence over the product and the motion around it.

You'll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you'll run engagements and help systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to own complex deployment outcomes end-to-end: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment
Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices
Run the execution motion: Hold a full book of concurrent deployments at different stages; coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders; keep cadence, risk tracking, and launch readiness current on every one without dropping threads
Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness
Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption
Support change management: Partner with client leadership on communicating the change through their organization, and identify where workflows or incentives need to shift for adoption to stick
Inform product development: Bring net-new workflow and product requirements to Product/Engineering, grounded in scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage
Contribute to the playbook: Feed lessons from engagements into the processes and templates that improve speed and quality as we scale
Support sales and expansion: Participate in later-stage sales and pre-sales discovery to set up successful engagements; help scope realistic engagements and identify follow-on opportunities
Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for founder-minded leaders who take pride in getting complex enterprise deployments live and keeping them healthy. You likely have:

5–8 years running enterprise software implementations, platform migrations, or technology transformation programs, for example implementation and delivery roles at enterprise SaaS companies, technology consulting, or systems integration
Demonstrated track record of taking enterprise deployments live: you can speak to specific implementations you’ve owned, the obstacles you hit, and how you got to launch
Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background
Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting
Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders
Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail
Willingness to travel ~2x per month for ~2-3 days
Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

Equity in the company
Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%
Fully paid parental leave
Commuter benefits
401k benefits
Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters
A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office
Unlimited vacation and paid holidays
We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000 USD/CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist Lead, Future Platforms | Housing
jobs.description:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.
Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As an Deployment Strategist on the Future Platforms team, you'll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that centers on strategic execution, with real influence over the product and the motion around it.

You'll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you'll run engagements and help systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to own complex deployment outcomes end-to-end: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment
Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices
Run the execution motion: Hold a full book of concurrent deployments at different stages; coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders; keep cadence, risk tracking, and launch readiness current on every one without dropping threads
Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness
Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption
Support change management: Partner with client leadership on communicating the change through their organization, and identify where workflows or incentives need to shift for adoption to stick
Inform product development: Bring net-new workflow and product requirements to Product/Engineering, grounded in scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage
Contribute to the playbook: Feed lessons from engagements into the processes and templates that improve speed and quality as we scale
Support sales and expansion: Participate in later-stage sales and pre-sales discovery to set up successful engagements; help scope realistic engagements and identify follow-on opportunities
Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for founder-minded leaders who take pride in getting complex enterprise deployments live and keeping them healthy. You likely have:

5–8 years running enterprise software implementations, platform migrations, or technology transformation programs, for example implementation and delivery roles at enterprise SaaS companies, technology consulting, or systems integration
Demonstrated track record of taking enterprise deployments live: you can speak to specific implementations you’ve owned, the obstacles you hit, and how you got to launch
Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background
Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting
Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders
Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail
Willingness to travel ~2x per month for ~2-3 days
Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

Equity in the company
Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%
Fully paid parental leave
Commuter benefits
401k benefits
Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters
A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office
Unlimited vacation and paid holidays
We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000 USD/CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. jobs.description:
Meet The Smart Safety Company

At Safe Fleet our name says it all. We make fleet vehicles – and everyone in and around them – safer. Our fleet safety platform brings together best-in-class products, ground-breaking technology, and a 100-year history of fleet know-how and innovation to solve the world’s biggest fleet safety problems.

Our core value is safety. Without safety first, efficiency and productivity are not possible. This is true for our products, our culture, and our relationship with our community. Our vision is to reduce preventable deaths and injuries in and around fleet vehicles with a goal of ZERO accidents.

We are re-defining what safety means for fleets of every type – from school buses to waste collection trucks, firefighting to utility vehicles, police cruisers to delivery vans.

Whether you work in our Charlotte plant to build life-saving stop arms for school buses, or design advanced camera vision products in our Vancouver office, forge valves and high-quality nozzles to fight fires, or dream up new ways to protect fleet operators in our Corporate HQ in Kansas City, you’ll contribute to our goal to keep everyone safe.

We are a fast-growing manufacturing, service, and technology company with over 1700 employees in over 15 locations across Canada and the US. We’re looking for motivated self-starters with innovative thinking to join our team and help us achieve our growth and performance goals.

Position Summary

The Technical Project Manager is accountable for the technical delivery workstream supporting complex transit vehicle technology implementations. The role leads mechanical engineering coordination, vehicle configuration development, mounting and installation design, prototype and conditional-installation support, technical documentation, and controlled transfer of approved technical information to field teams.

This position combines technical judgment with disciplined workstream management. The Technical Project Manager partners closely with the Project Manager and Field Coordinator, but remains the primary owner for technical readiness, engineering deliverables, configuration accuracy, and technical issue resolution.

﻿duties & Responsibilities

﻿

Technical workstream planning and control

Develop and maintain the technical workstream plan, milestones, dependencies, resource assignments, priorities, and delivery forecasts in alignment with the integrated project schedule.
Lead and coordinate mechanical engineering and technical writing activities, collaborating with engineering teams and technical writers to ensure accurate, high-quality outcomes.
Coordinate product, supply-chain, production, quality, and field-support resources across vehicle types and project phases.
Maintain technical action, risk, issue, decision, dependency, and change records; assign owners and due dates and drive items to verified technical closure.
Provide accurate technical status, schedule impacts, risks, assumptions, and decisions to the Project Manager and customer-facing team.
Provide technical dependencies, configuration requirements, material lead-time assumptions, and engineering estimates for schedule recovery, kit-demand planning, and production forecasting.
Escalate resource, design, approval, configuration, and documentation constraints before they affect prototypes, production, or field installation.

Vehicle engineering and installation readiness

﻿Plan and lead the technical portions of vehicle surveys, engineering reviews, dry fits, prototypes, first-of-type builds, conditional installations, and technical acceptance activities.
Confirm mounting solutions, hardware, cabling, connections, materials, drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and installation methods meet contractual requirements, customer standards, and actual vehicle conditions.
Coordinate technical decisions with Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Field Service, Installation, and the customer; document approved direction and downstream actions.
Evaluate field discoveries and technical defects, establish containment and corrective action, and verify that approved resolutions are implemented across affected vehicles and documents.
Support OEM and retrofit configuration alignment by applying validated lessons from surveys, prototypes, and production installations.

Documentation, configuration, and change control

﻿Own technical review and release coordination for installation guides, engineering drawings, BOMs, technical bulletins, configuration records, and related deliverables.
Perform quality reviews for technical accuracy, revision alignment, usability, completeness, and consistency before information is released to the customer or field teams.
Lead or support Engineering Change Order reviews, technical impact analysis, required approvals, and coordinated updates to drawings, BOMs, guides, work instructions, and affected configurations.
Own the technical intake and disposition of urgent parts requests and BOM-change requests; confirm technical suitability, obtain required engineering approvals, and release controlled revisions before field use.
Translate survey, dry-fit, prototype, and field feedback into repeatable approved installation instructions before scaled deployment.
Develop standard work, review checklists, approval workflows, naming conventions, and controlled repositories to reduce single-person dependency and preserve program knowledge.

Technical stakeholder leadership

Serve as Safe Fleet's technical project contact during engineering reviews, readiness meetings, field investigations, demonstrations, and customer approval activities.
Explain technical decisions, alternatives, constraints, and risks clearly to customer, project, field, and leadership audiences.
Facilitate rapid technical triage while maintaining engineering authority, change control, documentation, and safety requirements.
Participate in the defined after-hours coverage rotation as the technical escalation owner and document decisions for the Project Manager and next-shift handoff.
Provide technical coaching and knowledge transfer to installers, field leads, support personnel, and designated backup resources.

New York Pay Transparency:
$125,000 - $145,000 USD Annual

﻿*At Safe Fleet, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Our core values of integrity, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and safety guide our efforts to provide a workplace where all employees can thrive and reach their full potential.

Bachelor's degree in mechanical, electrical, systems, manufacturing, or engineering technology; equivalent relevant technical experience may be considered.
Five or more years of experience leading technical delivery in vehicle systems, transportation, systems integration, manufacturing, engineering, or field implementation.
Working knowledge of electromechanical vehicle installations, technical drawings, BOMs, configuration management, installation documentation, and engineering change control.
Experience coordinating engineers, technical writers, suppliers, production personnel, installers, field-service teams, and customer technical stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to plan technical work, manage dependencies and risks, document decisions, communicate schedule impacts, and drive technical actions to closure.
Strong technical writing, review, troubleshooting, facilitation, and customer communication skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration/document-control tools; ability to learn or use Jira, Confluence, SharePoint/OneDrive, Salesforce, and Arena.
Valid driver's license, ability to satisfy applicable site-access requirements, and ability to travel and work flexible shifts at customer and field locations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with public transportation agencies, vehicle retrofits, onboard video, communications systems, or multi-vehicle equipment rollouts.
Project-management certification or demonstrated formal project-management training.
Experience with requirements traceability, prototype validation, customer acceptance, quality gates, and production-readiness reviews.
Professional Engineer license or advanced engineering credential.

About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.
Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As an Deployment Strategist on the Future Platforms team, you'll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that centers on strategic execution, with real influence over the product and the motion around it.

You'll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you'll run engagements and help systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to own complex deployment outcomes end-to-end: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment
Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices
Run the execution motion: Hold a full book of concurrent deployments at different stages; coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders; keep cadence, risk tracking, and launch readiness current on every one without dropping threads
Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness
Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption
Support change management: Partner with client leadership on communicating the change through their organization, and identify where workflows or incentives need to shift for adoption to stick
Inform product development: Bring net-new workflow and product requirements to Product/Engineering, grounded in scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage
Contribute to the playbook: Feed lessons from engagements into the processes and templates that improve speed and quality as we scale
Support sales and expansion: Participate in later-stage sales and pre-sales discovery to set up successful engagements; help scope realistic engagements and identify follow-on opportunities
Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for founder-minded leaders who take pride in getting complex enterprise deployments live and keeping them healthy. You likely have:

5–8 years running enterprise software implementations, platform migrations, or technology transformation programs, for example implementation and delivery roles at enterprise SaaS companies, technology consulting, or systems integration
Demonstrated track record of taking enterprise deployments live: you can speak to specific implementations you’ve owned, the obstacles you hit, and how you got to launch
Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background
Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting
Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders
Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail
Willingness to travel ~2x per month for ~2-3 days
Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

Equity in the company
Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%
Fully paid parental leave
Commuter benefits
401k benefits
Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters
A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office
Unlimited vacation and paid holidays
We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000 USD/CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

God teknisk, operasjonell og kommersiell forståelse

Manage engineering review of permit applications, engineering design plans and specifications, standby plans and engineering contracts, integrated waste management plans, and periodic construction inspections, to ensure compliance with applicable state and/or federal regulations and sound engineering practice and standards.
Meet with various public or private entities or individuals to discuss issues relating to a variety of engineering/construction challenges and programs.
Ensure technical reports and presentations explain research, findings, and recommendations to prevent, control, restore, or address engineering, design, and/or construction issues or opportunities.
Develop a client base for providing high level civil engineering services including identifying additional business development opportunities.
Mentor staff to support their growth and professional development.
Remain current in latest civil engineering techniques and practices.
Collaborates with professionals from a variety of disciplines, other engineers, planners, and infrastructure authorities on Federal, State, regional, and locally funded improvement and development projects, as well as proposal and business development opportunities.
Support WSP’s marketing team, as required, when preparing proposals and/or responses to client issued Requests for Qualifications.
Represent WSP and participate in Industry Engagement Events and professional societies.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, or equivalent.
10+ years of relevant post education experience in transportation engineering and civil design.
Engineer license required (multi-state preferred).
Highly proficient with civil engineering principles, practices, process, design/build, and the application to permitting and project work-related issues.
Highly proficient with transportation infrastructure design.
Experience with infrastructure planning, design, and program/construction management; including project involvement in a variety of rehabilitation and reconstruction, new design, and construction projects.
Strong knowledge of relevant civil construction laws, codes, regulations, compliance practices, and record-keeping requirements.
Highly proficient with making technical computations and calculations involving the application of engineering principles, understanding plans and specifications, and making factual comparisons to the appropriate regulations.
Experience with planning and conducting inspections and investigations on various aspects of the construction and design of facilities or structures, applying applicable regulations and policies.
Highly effective interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing intricate ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non-engineering audience.
Strong self-leadership and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively, persuasively, and tactfully interact with clients, regulators, project managers, and employees at all levels of the organization.
Works independently to provide guidance and leadership to mid-level to senior level team or project members, with strict adherence to QA/QC.
Proficiency with technical writing, office automation, discipline-specific design software (i.e., MicroStation, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, ArcGIS, InRoads), technology, math principles, predictive models, spreadsheets, and tools.
Experienced with providing critical review for documents and preparing technical deliverables and plans with a high degree of complexity.
Well-developed critical thinking and problem-solving skills required to apply technical knowledge to reach conclusions from testing results, data collation, computations, statistical analysis and arriving at the most effective, economical, and logical solution.
Demonstrated effectiveness at coordinating and assertively directing subcontractors and others to consistently complete tasks safely and efficiently.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Must be flexible to a variety of schedules to meet business needs and able to prioritize responsibilities and quickly adapt to change in a pressure work environment.
Occasional travel may be required (including overnight stays) depending on project-specific requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Engineering.

Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.

Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.
Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.

Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.

Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic

Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.

Create scenario models, forecasts, and advanced analyses to quantify the impact of talent decisions on financial outcomes, including salary, equity, and other workforce-related expenses.
Gather, integrate, and synthesize HR data from various sources, transforming extensive datasets into scalable analytical models, actionable insights, and compelling data visualizations.
Serve as a subject matter expert on people data, analytical methodologies, and tools, providing guidance to stakeholders on metrics, approaches, and best practices for workforce analysis.

About The Company

Rural King is America's Farm and Home Store, dedicated to providing essential products to rural communities across the nation. With a diverse selection ranging from food and feed to farm and home supplies, Rural King operates over 150 locations spanning 17 states. The company is committed to growth and expansion, with an annual sales volume exceeding $2.5 billion. Headquartered in Mattoon, Illinois, Rural King boasts a robust distribution network and flagship stores that serve as the cornerstone of its operations. The company prides itself on creating a unique shopping experience, offering complimentary popcorn and coffee to customers as a token of appreciation. Rural King values its associates and fosters a positive, growth-oriented workplace environment, emphasizing professional development, competitive benefits, and a people-first culture. Joining Rural King means becoming part of a passionate team dedicated to making a meaningful difference in rural communities while providing opportunities for personal and professional growth.

About The Role

The Inventory Analyst at Rural King plays a vital role in maintaining accurate inventory records across all store locations and distribution centers. This position involves analyzing inventory data, verifying physical counts, and collaborating with various departments such as Accounts Payable, Purchasing, IT, and Distribution Center Operations to ensure inventory integrity. The Inventory Analyst will be responsible for generating detailed reports, researching discrepancies, and supporting process improvements related to receiving, purchasing, and inventory management. This role requires a proactive approach to problem-solving, strong analytical skills, and the ability to act as a trusted partner across departments. The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, highly organized, and committed to maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and confidentiality. This position offers an opportunity to contribute directly to operational efficiencies and decision-making processes that impact the company's overall success.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will possess a minimum of three years of experience in data analysis or a related field, demonstrating a strong ability to interpret complex data sets and generate actionable insights. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, is essential for creating and analyzing reports. Candidates should have excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with a customer service-oriented mindset. The ability to prioritize tasks effectively, meet deadlines, and pay close attention to detail is critical. Familiarity with inventory management systems and basic accounting principles is preferred. Analyze inventory data from store, distribution center, and internet inventories, providing weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports to identify discrepancies and trends.

Create and review reports essential for inventory research and the management of the 1301 account, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support initiatives that enhance operational performance and business outcomes.
Exercise discretion and independent judgment in daily decision-making, maintaining confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
Participate actively in training programs, workshops, and webinars to stay current with industry best practices and enhance skill sets.

Uphold Rural King's core values of People First, Integrity, Attitude, Initiative, Teamwork, Accountability, and Continuous Improvement in all interactions.

new_jobs.title: Deployment Strategist Lead, Future Platforms | Housing
new_jobs.description:
About EliseAI

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.
Healthcare: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.

The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.

Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

Future Platforms will operate as a startup within a startup, run like a Seed or Series A company but with the capital, resources, and market access of a well-funded Series E, deep C-suite involvement (CEO, CRO, CSO, CTO) and founder-level ownership from day one.

About The Role

As an Deployment Strategist on the Future Platforms team, you'll help found and scale a critical new function at EliseAI: taking our future platform products from early customer promise to live, adopted, business-impacting deployments. This is a cross-functional, high-autonomy role that centers on strategic execution, with real influence over the product and the motion around it.

You'll act as the primary driver of engagement success: building alignment across complex customer stakeholder groups, guiding high-stakes implementation and workflow decisions, and coordinating tightly with Product and Engineering to translate real-world needs into clear requirements and shipped improvements. Because this platform is early-stage and scaling quickly, you'll run engagements and help systematize how we do them, building repeatable playbooks, processes, and systems that let us scale rapidly without losing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to own complex deployment outcomes end-to-end: comfortable with ambiguity, strong in stakeholder management and execution, energized by building internal systems that scale, and willing to do whatever it takes to drive customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own engagement success end-to-end: Serve as the primary driver of customer deployments from late-stage sales handoff through launch and post-launch stabilization; ensure outcomes, timelines, and stakeholder alignment
Lead discovery, scoping, and decisioning: Translate fuzzy goals into crisp requirements, workflows, success metrics, and rollout plans; guide customers through tradeoffs, product constraints, and adoption choices
Run the execution motion: Hold a full book of concurrent deployments at different stages; coordinate internal teams and client stakeholders; keep cadence, risk tracking, and launch readiness current on every one without dropping threads
Run the execution motion: Maintain multi-threaded project plans under ambiguity; coordinate across internal teams and external stakeholders; create clear operating cadences, risk tracking, and launch readiness
Configuration and launch: Collaborate with product operations, engineering, and training teams to drive product configuration, data migration, launch, and successful adoption
Support change management: Partner with client leadership on communicating the change through their organization, and identify where workflows or incentives need to shift for adoption to stick
Inform product development: Bring net-new workflow and product requirements to Product/Engineering, grounded in scoping learnings, customer input, and real-world usage
Contribute to the playbook: Feed lessons from engagements into the processes and templates that improve speed and quality as we scale
Support sales and expansion: Participate in later-stage sales and pre-sales discovery to set up successful engagements; help scope realistic engagements and identify follow-on opportunities
Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

We’re scaling fast, solving real client problems with precision and ambition. Here, you own your impact; full autonomy, no micromanagement, no fluff.

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do. If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard.

Requirements

We’re looking for founder-minded leaders who take pride in getting complex enterprise deployments live and keeping them healthy. You likely have:

5–8 years running enterprise software implementations, platform migrations, or technology transformation programs, for example implementation and delivery roles at enterprise SaaS companies, technology consulting, or systems integration
Demonstrated track record of taking enterprise deployments live: you can speak to specific implementations you’ve owned, the obstacles you hit, and how you got to launch
Strong technical intuition, demonstrated by STEM degree or equivalent technical background
Proven ability to take ownership and operate autonomously with strong judgement in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
Proven ability to independently manage complex projects end-to-end in a client facing setting
Excellent communication and ability to naturally build strong relationships and influence across internal and external stakeholders
Ability to operate creatively and flexibly while maintaining sharp attention to detail
Willingness to travel ~2x per month for ~2-3 days
Willingness to work in person at our office 4-5 days a week

Why Join

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn!) startup that’s scaling so fast. That means that instead of following a playbook, you’ll be writing it. Every single day you will be challenged to identify how we can scale and execute on it. You’ll learn what works when you succeed and what doesn’t when you fail. Either way, the rest of the team will be here to support you.

Benefits

In addition to the growth and impact you’ll have at EliseAI, we offer competitive salaries along with the following benefits:

Equity in the company
Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100%
Fully paid parental leave
Commuter benefits
401k benefits
Fitness & home services stipend to cover part of your expenses so you can focus on what matters
A collaborative in-office environment with an open floor plan, fully stocked kitchen, and all meals covered in the office
Unlimited vacation and paid holidays
We'll cover relocation packages and make the move exciting, not painful!

Job Compensation Range

The salary range for this role is $190,000 - $250,000 USD/CAD. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We will also consider qualified applicants in accordance with the Austin Fair Chance Hiring Ordinance.

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at interview.accommodations@meetelise.com.

Colliers Engineering & Design is currently seeking a well-rounded, highly motivated engineer who is already a Project Manager, or ready to become one, to join our Holmdel, NJ Structural team, working on civil, marine, and amusement design projects.

Our structural group is growing, and we need a forward-thinking engineer, eager to learn and grow. Our work is very hands-on and diverse. The work scope ranges from proposal preparation to final design and construction support services.

Our people first culture, cutting edge projects, and collaborative environment make this an exciting opportunity to grow, innovate, and make a lasting impact. At Colliers Engineering & Design we build careers.

Prepare engineering designs and/or technical data.
Perform and oversee the work and productivity on assigned projects.
Manage the preparation of construction documents (drawings, specifications, estimates, etc.).

Participate in formulating and coordinating proposals and provide other marketing support, including business development.

Strive to achieve predetermined goals for profit, productivity targets, and schedule of deliverables.
