Our core value is safety. Without safety first, efficiency and productivity are not possible. This is true for our products, our culture, and our relationship with our community. Our vision is to reduce preventable deaths and injuries in and around fleet vehicles with a goal of ZERO accidents.

We are re-defining what safety means for fleets of every type – from school buses to waste collection trucks, firefighting to utility vehicles, police cruisers to delivery vans.

Whether you work in our Charlotte plant to build life-saving stop arms for school buses, or design advanced camera vision products in our Vancouver office, forge valves and high-quality nozzles to fight fires, or dream up new ways to protect fleet operators in our Corporate HQ in Kansas City, you’ll contribute to our goal to keep everyone safe.

We are a fast-growing manufacturing, service, and technology company with over 1700 employees in over 15 locations across Canada and the US. We’re looking for motivated self-starters with innovative thinking to join our team and help us achieve our growth and performance goals.

Position Summary

The Technical Project Manager is accountable for the technical delivery workstream supporting complex transit vehicle technology implementations. The role leads mechanical engineering coordination, vehicle configuration development, mounting and installation design, prototype and conditional-installation support, technical documentation, and controlled transfer of approved technical information to field teams.

This position combines technical judgment with disciplined workstream management. The Technical Project Manager partners closely with the Project Manager and Field Coordinator, but remains the primary owner for technical readiness, engineering deliverables, configuration accuracy, and technical issue resolution.

﻿duties & Responsibilities

﻿

Technical workstream planning and control

Develop and maintain the technical workstream plan, milestones, dependencies, resource assignments, priorities, and delivery forecasts in alignment with the integrated project schedule.
Lead and coordinate mechanical engineering and technical writing activities, collaborating with engineering teams and technical writers to ensure accurate, high-quality outcomes.
Coordinate product, supply-chain, production, quality, and field-support resources across vehicle types and project phases.
Maintain technical action, risk, issue, decision, dependency, and change records; assign owners and due dates and drive items to verified technical closure.
Provide accurate technical status, schedule impacts, risks, assumptions, and decisions to the Project Manager and customer-facing team.
Provide technical dependencies, configuration requirements, material lead-time assumptions, and engineering estimates for schedule recovery, kit-demand planning, and production forecasting.
Escalate resource, design, approval, configuration, and documentation constraints before they affect prototypes, production, or field installation.

Vehicle engineering and installation readiness

﻿Plan and lead the technical portions of vehicle surveys, engineering reviews, dry fits, prototypes, first-of-type builds, conditional installations, and technical acceptance activities.
Confirm mounting solutions, hardware, cabling, connections, materials, drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and installation methods meet contractual requirements, customer standards, and actual vehicle conditions.
Coordinate technical decisions with Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Field Service, Installation, and the customer; document approved direction and downstream actions.
Evaluate field discoveries and technical defects, establish containment and corrective action, and verify that approved resolutions are implemented across affected vehicles and documents.
Support OEM and retrofit configuration alignment by applying validated lessons from surveys, prototypes, and production installations.

Documentation, configuration, and change control

﻿Own technical review and release coordination for installation guides, engineering drawings, BOMs, technical bulletins, configuration records, and related deliverables.
Perform quality reviews for technical accuracy, revision alignment, usability, completeness, and consistency before information is released to the customer or field teams.
Lead or support Engineering Change Order reviews, technical impact analysis, required approvals, and coordinated updates to drawings, BOMs, guides, work instructions, and affected configurations.
Own the technical intake and disposition of urgent parts requests and BOM-change requests; confirm technical suitability, obtain required engineering approvals, and release controlled revisions before field use.
Translate survey, dry-fit, prototype, and field feedback into repeatable approved installation instructions before scaled deployment.
Develop standard work, review checklists, approval workflows, naming conventions, and controlled repositories to reduce single-person dependency and preserve program knowledge.

Technical stakeholder leadership

Serve as Safe Fleet's technical project contact during engineering reviews, readiness meetings, field investigations, demonstrations, and customer approval activities.
Explain technical decisions, alternatives, constraints, and risks clearly to customer, project, field, and leadership audiences.
Facilitate rapid technical triage while maintaining engineering authority, change control, documentation, and safety requirements.
Participate in the defined after-hours coverage rotation as the technical escalation owner and document decisions for the Project Manager and next-shift handoff.
Provide technical coaching and knowledge transfer to installers, field leads, support personnel, and designated backup resources.

Syteline (Infor CloudSuite Industrial) Business Analyst

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Syteline Business Analyst to lead functional design, configuration, testing and deployment of Syteline (Infor CloudSuite Industrial) ERP solutions. The role partners with business stakeholders and technical teams to gather requirements, perform gap analysis, define solutions, manage integrations and support go-live and post-implementation activities to ensure the ERP delivers expected business value.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with stakeholders to elicit and document business requirements, use cases, user stories and functional specifications for Syteline implementations and enhancements.
Perform business process analysis, gap analysis and solution design across Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Inventory, MRP/Manufacturing, Fixed Assets, HCM/Payroll and Financial modules (GL/AP/AR).
Configure and validate Syteline system settings and support safe customization where needed, ensuring alignment with best practices and governance.
Design, execute and oversee integration and data migration activities including data mapping, ETL processes, EDI, REST/SOAP APIs and middleware coordination.
Develop and execute test plans, test cases and UAT scripts; coordinate integration testing, UAT and defect resolution with technical teams and business users.
Create and maintain implementation artifacts including BRDs, functional specifications, process diagrams (Visio/Lucidchart), training materials and release documentation.
Partner with technical teams on reporting and analytics requirements, supporting SQL/PL/SQL, T-SQL, SSRS, Power BI, Tableau or Crystal Reports delivery where applicable.
Work within Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall project methodologies, using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, HP ALM or TestRail to manage requirements, sprints and defects.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of hands-on ERP business analysis experience, with strong experience specifically on Syteline (Infor CloudSuite Industrial) implementations preferred.
Proven expertise in requirements gathering, business process analysis, gap analysis, functional specifications, user stories, BRDs and test case creation.
Experience with data migration, ETL, data mapping, master data management and SQL (PL/SQL, T-SQL) for data validation and reporting.
Familiarity with integrations and middleware (APIs, REST, SOAP, EDI, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Informatica, Tibco or similar) and experience coordinating integration testing.
Strong reporting and analytics skills (SSRS, Power BI, Tableau, Crystal Reports) and advanced Excel including VBA for analysis and reconciliation.
Preferred: familiarity with other ERP platforms and technologies, including SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Fusion/Cloud ERP, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, Microsoft Dynamics/Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Workday, and ABAP familiarity.

This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

This organization operates in the AI infrastructure industry, providing GPU cloud services designed to support AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. It addresses challenges in AI development complexity by offering cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure that supports technical capabilities and strategic business outcomes such as cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

About the Opportunity:

The TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER - CYBER DEFENSE, METRICS AND BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE role is focused on transforming rapid security initiatives into structured programs with measurable outcomes and transparent reporting for leadership. This position bridges several security domains, including Incident Response, Pen Testing, Enterprise Security, Cyber Defense, and GRC, by combining technical program management with business intelligence skills. The role enhances security scale and effectiveness by providing clarity, early identification of blockers, and evidence-based metrics to improve deployment readiness, compliance, and risk mitigation.

Responsibilities:

Lead delivery of security programs including cyber defense, incident response, security testing, detection, and compliance initiatives.
Structure fast-moving security programs with clear ownership, milestones, and decision points.
Track dependencies, status, and remediation across multiple teams.
Escalate issues promptly and guide teams to resolution.
Define and implement security metrics covering delivery, coverage, risk, control health, exceptions, and evidence quality.
Develop executive-level reports translating technical work into business impact.
Create dashboards reflecting coverage, blockers, overdue items, and residual risks.
Model security program data across various assets and processes.
Establish recurring program reviews, escalation processes, roadmap tracking, and reporting rhythms.
Maintain decision logs and action tracking for cross-functional initiatives.
Develop prioritization and intake processes to clarify focus and risk acceptance.
Enhance execution efficiency with lightweight governance mechanisms.
Coordinate across security, IT, engineering, compliance, and operations to maintain alignment.
Identify and address gaps in data sources for security reporting.
Support audit readiness through traceability of decisions, controls, and remediation.
Reduce manual status reporting and improve leadership visibility of risk and progress.

Requirements:

Minimum 6 years in technical program management, security program management, business intelligence engineering, data analytics, security operations, or related fields.
Experience collaborating with security, IT, infrastructure, cloud, identity, cyber defense, GRC, or engineering teams, especially in incident response contexts.
Strong skills in business intelligence including data modeling, metric development, dashboard creation, and data quality management.
Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs with ambiguous requirements.
Capability to translate technical security information into clear executive reports.
Strong written communication, issue framing, decision tracking, and stakeholder management abilities.
Practical knowledge of security concepts such as identity, endpoint security, vulnerability management, incident response, access control, logging, compliance, and risk management.
Experience designing lightweight mechanisms that improve execution without excessive process overhead.
Preferred experience in high-growth technology, cloud, infrastructure, AI, regulated, or customer-trust-sensitive sectors.
Familiarity with security dashboards, control-health reporting, risk registers, audit evidence views, and related tools is a plus.
